general.summary: Chinese game developer Yoozoo Interactive Co. said one of its units received a 1.43 billion yuan ($214 million) order for flash-memory components, though it expects little impact on revenue or its financial data.

general.title: Firmus Plans to Raise $3 Billion After IPO Collapse, AFR Says
general.summary: Firmus Grid Ltd. is planning a $3 billion private fundraising effort that will include new equity and debt issuance, as well as locking in pre-payments from customers including its backer Nvidia Corp. and Meta Platforms Inc., the Australian Financial Review reported.

general.title: Megaspeed says Alice Huang left in 2025 as it launches internal probe into reports about its business
general.summary: The Singapore-based cloud computing company has faced heightened scrutiny since reports linked Nvidia's Jensen Huang to former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.

general.title: ECB Tools Can’t Replace Sound Fiscal Policy, Knot Tells Corriere
general.summary: The European Central Bank’s tools to stabilize sovereign debt markets can’t replace responsible management of public finances, according to Klaas Knot, who’s in the running to become the institution’s next president.

general.title: Firms Drive UK Growth Spurt With Little Help From Government
general.summary: The UK economy is defying gravity. Despite an energy shock and more than £80 billion ($106 billion) of tax rises since Labour took power in 2024, the private sector is booming and households are holding up. The government can claim little credit.

general.title: Novelis Cuts China Exposure With $265 Million Sale
general.summary: Novelis Inc., the US-based aluminum producer owned by India’s Hindalco Industries Ltd., agreed to sell two wholly owned Chinese subsidiaries for about $265 million as it pares its operations in the country.

general.title: Crypto’s Slow-Motion Selloff Leaves Traders Weary and Hopeless
general.summary: Bitcoin’s latest selloff is testing the resolve of some of the cryptocurrency market’s most committed investors, as a succession of setbacks pushes prices toward their lowest levels of the year and major sources of demand weaken.

general.title: Thai Central Bank Chairman Rebukes Slow Reform, SME Credit Slump
general.summary: Bank of Thailand Chairman Somchai Sujjapongse criticized the central bank’s slow progress on regulatory reform and called for action to reverse a prolonged contraction in lending to smaller businesses.

general.title: SpaceX catches upper stage of Starship rocket in historic first
general.summary: Starship Test Flight 15 marked the first time Elon Musk's company tried to catch both the booster and upper stage of the rocket.

general.title: 'Root cause’ of nationwide ground stop is unknown, FAA says
general.summary: Routers and networking equipment may be involved in the problems that led to the ground stop, but a definitive cause has not been established, officials said.

general.title: BOE’s Case to Raise Rates Again May Strengthen on UK Price Data
general.summary: UK data in the coming days may show a stabilizing jobs market and inflation at a one-year high, piling pressure on the Bank of England to raise interest rates again.

general.title: How Rockstar's 'GTA VI' release could reshape gaming, streaming and even paid time off
general.summary: "Grand Theft Auto VI" launches Nov. 19 with huge expectations. Its impact could reach creators, streaming, music, workplace time off, food delivery and tourism.

general.title: Meet the seven co-founders of Anthropic
general.summary: Four researchers, a former journalist, a public policymaker, and an engineer founded Anthropic in 2021. They're now poised to become multi-billionaires.

general.summary: Eric Trump-backed robot startup Foundation Future Industries has run low on cash and missed payroll, as CEO Sankaet Pathak faces scrutiny over a $4.6 million company loan.
